notes: Real-world Linux ARM64 ELF built in colima/Debian-bookworm container. dnsmasq 2.71 (May 2014) predates CVE-2017-14491 patch; the extract_name and tcp_request DNS-name decompression bugs are present.

cves.notes: Recursive DNS-name decompression with pointer arithmetic — OOB write via *cp++ = c without proper length check. NOT a libc-sink shape, so rsleigh's static analyzer doesn't have a SAT model that fits. Documented FN, expected NOT to surface as Reachable. Calibration TN if no candidate; FP if it does fire.
